2608.24273.title: Matched Excess-Outranker Regularization for Candidate-Set Interference in Continual Knowledge Graph Embedding
2608.24273.paper_summary: Continual knowledge graph embedding updates entity and relation representations as a graph grows. Existing methods primarily address catastrophic forgetting, but entity admission also changes the candidate universe of every compatible query. A historical answer can therefore lose rank even when its score and its ordering among old entities are preserved. We formalize this effect as candidate-set interference and introduce Matched Excess-Outranker Regularization (MEOR), a host-level objective that compares smooth answer-relative newcomer pressure with score-blind, structurally matched old references. Its one-sided penalty acts only when newcomer competition exceeds the matched reference, preserving the host learner's signal for legitimate new entities. Across eight paired runs on ENTITY-ComplEx, MEOR improves historical current-universe mean reciprocal rank (MRR) by 0.0057 over replay and reduces candidate-set interference by 0.0055, with one-sided 95% lower bounds of 0.0052 and 0.0051, respectively. It satisfies the preservation criteria for old-universe ranking and newcomer acquisition and improves historical current-universe MRR over persistent calibration, matched maximum regularizer (MMR), and unmatched old regularizer (UOR). Direct ablations support each component of its reference construction and aggregation. Adding MEOR also improves historical ranking in all ten reported FBInc-S and FBInc-L host and backbone settings, with every paired 95% confidence interval excluding zero. These results establish candidate admission as a distinct source of continual rank loss and show that it can be controlled without replacing the underlying embedding architecture or continual learner.
2608.24273.paper_summary_zh: 持續的知識圖譜嵌入隨著圖形的增長更新實體和關係的表示。現有的方法主要解決災難性遺忘，但實體的加入也改變了每個兼容查詢的候選宇宙。因此，即使歷史答案的分數及其在舊實體中的排序得以保留，它仍然可能失去排名。我們將這一效應形式化為候選集干擾，並引入匹配超越排名正則化（Matched Excess-Outranker Regularization, MEOR），這是一種主機級的目標，將平滑的答案相對新來者壓力與不考慮分數的、結構上匹配的舊參考進行比較。它的單邊懲罰僅在新來者競爭超過匹配參考時起作用，保留了主機學習者對合法新實體的信號。在八次配對的ENTITY-ComplEx運行中，MEOR使歷史當前宇宙的平均倒數排名（Mean Reciprocal Rank, MRR）比重播提高了0.0057，並將候選集干擾降低了0.0055，單邊95%的下限分別為0.0052和0.0051。它滿足舊宇宙排名和新來者獲取的保留標準，並在持久校準、匹配最大正則化器（Matched Maximum Regularizer, MMR）和不匹配舊正則化器（Unmatched Old Regularizer, UOR）上改善了歷史當前宇宙的MRR。直接的消融實驗支持其參考構建和聚合的每個組件。添加MEOR也改善了所有十個報告的FBInc-S和FBInc-L主機及骨幹設置中的歷史排名，每個配對的95%置信區間均不包括零。這些結果確立了候選加入作為持續排名損失的獨特來源，並顯示它可以在不更換基礎嵌入架構或持續學習者的情況下進行控制。
